dandi-000623.source: Keles et al. 2024, Sci Data 11:214; release code at commit 8c35290b
reproduced: units with no spike during movie_onset (encoding) are dropped
only correct trials (response_correct 1) are tested and counted per level
HFB power z-scored across the time series of the task phase, then averaged across bands
not_reproduced: behavioural AUC filter: the paper says sessions with AUC > 0.6 are excluded, the release code excludes AUC < 0.6; exclude_sessions_auc_below follows the code; the filter itself is not applied here
balanced resampling to min(n_novel, n_familiar) in the recognition test
ground-truth class (stimulus file new/old) combined with the response side
iEEG channels restricted to AMY, HIP, ACC, SMA and OFC
HFB z-score over the whole task phase: zscore_over_time pools each frequency over the events' read windows only
